## GPT-5.3 Codex API

GPT-5.3 Codex is a large language model by OpenAI, available on the Venice API as `openai-gpt-53-codex`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

GPT-5.3 Codex, the successor to GPT-5.2 Codex, is OpenAI's specialized coding model, optimized for advanced software development, code generation, and technical problem-solving. It supports a longer context window and longer outputs than GPT-5.2 Codex.

### GPT-5.3 Codex API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `openai-gpt-53-codex` | Standard | Anonymized | $1.75 / $14.00 per 1M |

### GPT-5.3 Codex specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | OpenAI |
| Released | Feb 24, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 400K tokens |
| Max output | 128K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | none, low, medium, high, xhigh |

### How to use the GPT-5.3 Codex API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses` with `"model": "openai-gpt-53-codex"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "openai-gpt-53-codex",
    "input": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences.",
    "reasoning": { "effort": "high" }
  }'
```
